SELECT cai.point_id AS pointId, COUNT(*) AS count FROM conversation_analysis_item cai INNER JOIN conversation_analysis ca ON cai.analysis_id = ca.analysis_id WHERE ca.user_id = #{userId} AND ca.status = 'success' AND cai.point_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cai.point_id ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cai.analysis_id, cai.sentence_id) FROM conversation_analysis_item cai INNER JOIN conversation_analysis ca ON cai.analysis_id = ca.analysis_id WHERE ca.user_id = #{userId} AND ca.status = 'success' AND cai.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{fromDaysAgo} DAY) AND cai.created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{toDaysAgo} DAY)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(cai.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(DISTINCT cai.analysis_id, cai.sentence_id) AS count FROM conversation_analysis_item cai INNER JOIN conversation_analysis ca ON cai.analysis_id = ca.analysis_id WHERE ca.user_id = #{userId} AND ca.status = 'success' AND cai.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(cai.created_at) ORDER BY day ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(cai.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(*) AS count FROM conversation_analysis_item cai INNER JOIN conversation_analysis ca ON cai.analysis_id = ca.analysis_id WHERE ca.user_id = #{userId} AND ca.status = 'success' AND cai.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(cai.created_at) ORDER BY day ASC

SELECT cai.id, cai.analysis_id, cai.sentence_id, cai.original_sentence, cai.problem_types, cai.point_id, cai.error_point, cai.suggestion, cai.created_at FROM conversation_analysis_item cai INNER JOIN conversation_analysis ca ON cai.analysis_id = ca.analysis_id INNER JOIN (SELECT analysis_id, sentence_id, MAX(created_at) AS max_created FROM conversation_analysis_item GROUP BY analysis_id, sentence_id) t ON cai.analysis_id = t.analysis_id AND cai.sentence_id = t.sentence_id AND cai.created_at = t.max_created WHERE ca.user_id = #{userId} AND ca.status = 'success' ORDER BY t.max_created DESC LIMIT #{limit}
